Briar|jgl.identity: Physical damage fighter, an ultra-aggressive diving jungler. Her passive makes her targets bleed and heals her more when she's low. Head Rush (Q) leaps onto a target, briefly stuns it and lowers its resistances; Blood Frenzy (W) makes her leap and go into a frenzy (she automatically attacks the nearest target, champions first), with Snack Attack as a recast for a big healing bite; Chilling Scream (E) reduces the damage she takes, then knocks back (stunning against a wall); Certain Death (R) launches her onto the first champion hit at very long range.
Briar|jgl.playstyle: Gank and skirmish jungler who wins through aggression and diving. During the frenzy you don't control your target: you have to pick the right moment to start it.
Briar|jgl.early_game: Clear fast with W (frenzy) and the recast bite to heal. Gank from level 3 when a lane can follow up: Q to stun, W for the frenzy, E if your opponent tries to run against a wall. Don't start the frenzy in the middle of several minions if you want to hit the champion: it targets champions first, but position matters.
Briar|jgl.level_1: Blood Frenzy (W) first. Frenzy on the first camp, then recast Snack Attack to heal.
Briar|jgl.level_2: Chilling Scream (E). Damage reduction while charging, then a knockback; against a wall, it stuns. Useful for camps and to keep a target in place.
Briar|jgl.level_3: Head Rush (Q). A leap that briefly stuns and lowers resistances: first gank with Q → W → attacks → Snack Attack. Max W first.
Briar|jgl.level_6: Certain Death: a very long-range projectile that flies you to the first champion hit and fears enemies around it. Perfect to join a fight from afar, finish a target or counter-gank. Careful: once it's cast, you're committed.
power_spikes: Level 3: first gank with Q → W.
Level 6: Certain Death for long-range ganks and counter-ganks.
First completed item: very strong tower dives.
Mid game: repeated skirmishes around objectives.
Briar|jgl.jungle_plan: Clear with W and the bite, then gank a lane with an opponent who has no escape from level 3-4. Briar is stronger at ganking and skirmishing than at pure farming: plan your paths to show up where your team has priority. Control Scuttle and invade enemy camps when your laners are ahead. Your ultimate lets you counter-gank from across the map. Play Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) with a lane that has priority, and keep an eye on dragons.
Briar|jgl.trading: Ganking: Q (stun) → W (frenzy) → attacks → recast Snack Attack → E if the target tries to run toward a wall. Skirmishing: start W when the champion you want is the closest one to you; otherwise you'll hit the wrong target. Give up on it when your health drops and you can't heal with the bite anymore.
threats: CC that cuts off your frenzy.
Champions who drag you into a bad spot during the frenzy (you don't choose your target).
Tanks who soak damage without dying (Cho'Gath, Rammus).
mistakes: Starting W in the middle of minions or several enemies and hitting the wrong target.
Casting your ultimate with no follow-up from your team.
Forgetting to recast Snack Attack to heal.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: You win short skirmishes thanks to the frenzy and heals; watch out for his Resonating Strike catching you.
matchup_notes.Viego: Win fights before he possesses one of your allies.
matchup_notes.Graves: He deals a lot of ranged damage: stick to him with Q, he can't kite you during the frenzy.
matchup_notes.Cho'Gath: His silence and his Feast punish you: avoid diving him alone.

Briar|jgl.mid_game: Skirmish around objectives, tower dive with your laners, and counter-gank with your ultimate. Briar is strong as long as she can fight often.
Briar|jgl.late_game: Dive the enemy carry with your ultimate or Q, frenzy to kill them. Wait for the enemy CC to be used before committing.
Briar|jgl.ahead: Tower dive, take objectives and force fights: a fed Briar is very hard to stop.
Briar|jgl.behind: Farm, play with your team and look for picks on isolated carries with your ultimate.
Briar|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to turn your aggression into kills and objectives, and dive the carries in teamfights.
Briar|jgl.final_tip: Before starting your frenzy, check that the champion you want really is the closest one to you.
